name: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
summary: Numerical solution of fluid-flow and heat-transfer problems, from discretisation schemes and turbulence models to validated engineering simulations.

topics.name: Governing equations in conservative form and their mathematical classification
Finite-difference methods: discretisation, consistency, stability (CFL) and convergence
Finite-volume method for diffusion and convection-diffusion problems
Convection schemes: upwind, central and high-resolution (TVD)
Pressure-velocity coupling: SIMPLE, PISO and projection methods
Mesh generation: structured, unstructured and boundary-layer meshing
Turbulence modeling: RANS (k-epsilon, k-omega SST), LES and DNS
Conjugate heat transfer and multiphase CFD
Practical CFD workflows (OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+)
